method: In-memory SQLite, fixed synthetic seed, no CPU profiler. Three fresh-process rounds per variant/size/profile; rotated original/before/after order. Each process measures empty sources/ranges, source-only, and source+range+attributes. Each shape has 3 warm-up and 15 measured calls; pooled P50/P95 use 45 samples. Output hashing is outside timing. RSS includes setup, Node/SQLite and all shapes, not function-only allocation. Original is pre-previous-optimization, before is the immediately preceding frozen release. No model, normal profile or network.
